description: This file defines a ValidationService class responsible for executing data validation runs, generating reports, and managing validation artifacts and reports within a data validation system. It includes methods for running validations, checking schema conformance, freshness, and completeness, and retrieving validation reports and run histories.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service for validation run execution and report generation.

methods.name: run_validation
methods.description: Executes a validation run for a submission, generates a report, stores artifacts, updates submission state, and records an audit event.

methods.name: _check_schema_conformance
methods.description: Checks if the dataset hash is a placeholder; fails if so, otherwise passes.

methods.name: _check_freshness
methods.description: Performs a freshness check on the dataset, currently always passes with fixed metrics.

methods.name: _check_completeness
methods.description: Performs a completeness check on the dataset, currently always passes with fixed metrics.

methods.name: get_validation_report
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report for a given validation run ID, loading from stored JSON if available.

methods.name: list_validation_runs
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a specific submission ID, ordered by creation time.
